significance: A reclining-Ranganatha Divya Desam at Koviladi on the Kaveri near Tiruchirappalli, and the only one of the 108 where the sweet neyyappam is offered to the deity every night.
story: Vishnu, disguised as a hungry old pilgrim, is said to have eaten king Upamanyu's entire food offering and been satisfied only by a pot of appam, lifting the king's curse.
